features.title: Feature Flags

features.title: Instant Rollback

features.title: Targeted Delivery

features.title: A/B Testing

about.missionTitle: We believe shipping fast shouldn't mean shipping blind.
about.missionText: OffOn was built for engineering teams who move fast and need control. We give you the rails to deploy with confidence, test in production safely, and roll back instantly if anything goes wrong. No ops tickets. No feature branches left open for weeks. Just clean, controlled delivery.

values.title: Transparency
values.description: Every flag, every change, every rollout is tracked and auditable end-to-end.

values.title: Speed
values.description: Zero-latency flag evaluation — your users never wait, your engineers never block.

values.title: Reliability
values.description: 99.99% uptime SLA. Your flags are always evaluated, even when things go wrong upstream.

careers.pageTitle: Build the future of feature delivery.
careers.pageSubtitle: We are a remote-first team that ships fast, thinks deeply, and values craft. Come build tools that thousands of engineers rely on every day.

jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer
jobs.description: Build and scale the core flag evaluation engine serving billions of requests per day. You will own reliability, performance, and the SDK ecosystem.

jobs.title: Frontend Engineer
jobs.description: Craft the dashboard UI that thousands of engineers use daily to manage their releases. React, TypeScript, and a strong design sensibility required.

jobs.title: Product Designer
jobs.description: Shape the user experience for developer tooling that balances power with simplicity. Own the full design process from discovery to shipped pixels.

jobs.title: Developer Advocate
jobs.description: Build relationships with developer communities and help teams get the most from OffOn. Write, speak, and ship sample apps that make the docs come alive.

jobs.title: Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: Own the reliability, observability, and performance of our global flag delivery infrastructure. Oncall with excellent tooling and a blameless culture.

jobs.title: Sales Engineer
jobs.description: Partner with enterprise prospects to demonstrate value and guide technical evaluation. Deep product knowledge and communication skills are your superpowers.
